page_title: UDI 1-1 EMP | Udinese v Empoli 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' That's the end of the match.
90+15' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) picks up his second yellow card from referee Marco Guida and is given his marching orders.
90+14' 1 - 1 Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) slides the penalty home!
90+13' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+12' The yellow card is received by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
90+10' There's a break in play and referee Marco Guida must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Udinese using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+9' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Udinese for a penalty. Play continues.
90+8' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.
90+7' Udinese have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Razvan Marin (Empoli) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' 46:54 – the latest ball possession ratio.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 1 Goal! Maduka Okoye gets a hand on the penalty from M'Baye Niang (Empoli), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
90' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
89' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. Penalty awarded! Empoli will take a penalty kick.
88' Razvan Marin (Empoli) steps up to send the ball in.
88' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
87' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to substitute Hassane Kamara and he is replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Walace cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Walace (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Empoli out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
83' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call.
82' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
81' That's the end of the game for Matteo Cancellieri, who is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli).
80' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Alberto Grassi is replaced by Razvan Marin (Empoli).
77' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
77' Keinan Davis (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
73' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands.
73' Marco Guida couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) and blew his whistle. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
68' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
67' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) sends a precise pass into the box, but Matteo Cancellieri loses the one-on-one with the defender.
65' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a free kick, but the defence is well positioned and clears the ball away from danger.
64' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
62' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
59' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) replaces Simone Bastoni.
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Bartosz Bereszynski as he is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli).
57' Keinan Davis (Udinese) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
55' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Festy Ebosele (Udinese) replacing Kingsley Ehizibue.
55' Today's match ends for Brenner who will be replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
54' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
47' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' Marco Guida blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Marco Guida had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

43' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Maduka Okoye allowed him to make a comfortable save.
42' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) prepares to take a corner kick.
41' Flag up against M'Baye Niang (Empoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
39' The Empoli players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Marco Guida signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to a handball.
37' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Empoli players aren’t happy.

36' The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Youssef Maleh (Empoli) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a strong shot into the top of the net. His attempt was beyond the reach of Maduka Okoye, so the score changes to 0:1.
36' Empoli are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
35' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Marco Guida and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
31' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
30' Alberto Cerri comes off the pitch to be replaced by M'Baye Niang (Empoli).
29' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
28' 3:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
28' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
25' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' Walace (Udinese) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
20' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Empoli.
19' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
16' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes.
13' The ball is cleared after Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
11' Walace (Udinese) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
11' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
8' There's an opportunity for Simone Bastoni (Empoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
7' Fabio Cannavaro is forced to make a change. Isaac Success is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Brenner (Udinese).
5' The game is interrupted now, Isaac Success (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
4' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick-off.
Marco Guida is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
